# awx_settings_debug (Resource)

This resource has no ID, so it cannot be imported. It manages a singleton that always exists in AWX. Declare it, and the first apply replaces the current values with yours.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `awx_cleanup_paths` (Boolean) Enable or Disable TMP Dir cleanup
- `awx_request_profile` (Boolean) Debug web request python timing
- `receptor_release_work` (Boolean) Release receptor work
